channel.title: GizmoTek.lk Product Feed
channel.description: Sri Lanka's premier online store for tech gadgets, smartwatches, wireless earbuds & accessories.

item.g:title: A58 Plus Luxury Women's 6-in-1 Smartwatch & Fashion Jewelry Gift Set (2.02" HD Display)
item.g:description: Elegant 6-in-1 women's smartwatch and luxury fashion gift set featuring a vibrant 2.02-inch HD full-touch display, 49mm modern curved square dial, and NFC smart functionality. Comes bundled in a premium presentation gift box complete with multiple interchangeable silicone and designer metal bracelet straps, matching fashion accessories, and a magnetic fast-charging dock. Perfect for casual wear, office elegance, or a stunning gift.

item.g:title: Jeqang Ergonomic 1200 DPI Wired USB Optical Gaming & Office Mouse
item.g:description: Versatile and comfortable full-size wired USB optical mouse designed for both gaming responsiveness and daily office workflow. Features a high-precision 1200 DPI optical sensor, contoured ergonomic handgrip with textured anti-slip side panels, responsive 3-button layout with a smooth scroll wheel, and driver-free plug-and-play USB connectivity.

item.g:title: Super Bass Wireless Bluetooth 5.3 Sports Neckband Earphones (20-Hour Playtime)
item.g:description: Premium high-fidelity wireless Bluetooth 5.3 neckband earphones equipped with custom-tuned 10mm neodymium acoustic drivers and AAC codec support for booming deep bass and crisp highs. Delivers an impressive 20-hour extended battery playtime, built-in noise-reduction HD microphone with inline media controls, and a lightweight flexible memory neckband tailored for travel, workouts, and daily calling.

item.g:title: FAIFA Minimalist Ultra-Thin Square LED Digital Sports Watch with Soft Silicone Strap
item.g:description: Sleek and lightweight unisex LED digital wristwatch featuring a modern smartwatch-inspired square dial and an ultra-thin 7mm profile. Equipped with a bright energy-efficient LED digital time/date display, high-transparency glass face, and a soft, flexible silicone wristband designed for comfortable all-day casual and sports wear.

item.g:title: Motorcycle & Bicycle Sun Visor Helmet Phone Mount Holder (Anti-Glare & Rain Shade)
item.g:description: Innovative motorcycle and bicycle handlebar phone mount equipped with an aerodynamic mini helmet sun visor. Effectively shields your smartphone display against harsh sunlight glare, screen reflections, thermal overheating, and rainfall during rides. Features a heavy-duty vibration-absorbing clamp, 360° rotatable view, and universal handlebar mounting.

item.g:title: Samsung 35W Dual-Port Super Fast Charging Power Adapter & Type-C Cable Set (UK 3-Pin)
item.g:description: High-performance Samsung 35W dual-port power adapter bundled with a high-speed Type-C fast charging cable. Features dual-port flexibility with a 35W USB-C Power Delivery (PD 3.0) port and a 15W USB-A Adaptive Fast Charging port, allowing simultaneous high-speed power delivery to Galaxy smartphones, tablets, iPhones, and accessories with built-in surge and thermal protection.

item.g:title: DZ09 Plus Multi-Language Standalone SIM Smartwatch Phone with Camera & TF Card Slot
item.g:description: Feature-packed standalone smartwatch phone with multi-language system support, dedicated Micro SIM cellular connectivity, and TF memory card expansion. Make standalone calls, reply to SMS, snap photos with the built-in 2.0MP camera, listen to local MP3 audio, and track daily fitness steps and sleep patterns directly from an ultra-responsive 1.44-inch color touchscreen.

item.g:title: Lenovo HE05 Pro Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Magnetic Sports Neckband Earphones
item.g:description: High-performance sports wireless neckband earphones engineered with an upgraded quad-driver acoustic system and composite bio-diaphragm for deep bass and detailed stereo sound. Features power-efficient Bluetooth 5.0, intelligent noise-reduction HD microphone, magnetic earbuds for tangle-free wear, flexible skin-friendly silicone neckband, and long battery endurance for workouts and all-day listening.

item.g:title: USB Wireless Bluetooth 4.0 Audio Music Receiver & Hands-Free Mic Adapter
item.g:description: Compact plug-and-play USB Bluetooth audio receiver that instantly upgrades non-Bluetooth car stereos, home theater soundbars, and speaker systems into wireless streaming receivers. Features Bluetooth 4.0 with EDR technology for clear 3 Mbps music streaming up to 30 feet, a built-in microphone for hands-free calling in the car, and direct USB bus-powering with no batteries or recharging needed.

item.g:title: Apple Original 20W USB-C Fast Power Adapter (UK 3-Pin Plug with Warranty)
item.g:description: Genuine Apple 20W USB-C Power Adapter featuring a UK standard 3-pin plug. Delivers high-speed Power Delivery (PD 3.0) fast charging, powering your iPhone up to 50% in approximately 30 minutes. Built with Apple intelligent IC protection to ensure low operating temperatures and comprehensive surge, overcharge, and short-circuit safety.

item.g:title: 120W 6A HyperCharge Super Fast Wall Charger Adapter & Type-C Cable Combo (CH-NOTE12)
item.g:description: Ultra-high-power 120W HyperCharge flash charging power adapter paired with a dedicated 6A high-current USB-C data cable. Engineered with advanced gallium/silicon power architecture and intelligent 10-layer thermal protection, capable of fueling compatible flagship smartphones to 100% battery in under 20 minutes while maintaining cool, safe operating temperatures.

item.g:title: Outdoor Waterproof IP65 LED Flickering Flame Atmosphere Bluetooth Speaker (2000mAh)
item.g:description: Stunning 2-in-1 outdoor ambiance lighting and wireless sound solution. Combines 96 warm amber LEDs creating a mesmerizing, hyper-realistic dancing flame effect with a powerful 5W Hi-Fi Bluetooth audio speaker. Built with IP65 weatherproofing to withstand rain, splashes, and dust, a 2000mAh rechargeable battery, and an integrated carry/hanging handle perfect for patio dinners, garden parties, camping, and indoor bedside relaxation.

item.g:title: Ergonomic 5-Level Adjustable Folding Laptop & Tablet Stand (ZM-020)
item.g:description: Lightweight and sturdy ergonomic laptop riser designed to improve posture and relieve neck strain. Features 5 customizable viewing angle levels, an open hollow-frame design for rapid laptop heat dissipation and ventilation, anti-slip silicone pads with front support hooks, and a fully collapsible flat-fold structure for easy carrying in laptop bags.

item.g:title: K8 Wireless Plug-and-Play Lavalier Lapel Microphone with Type-C Receiver (20M Range)
item.g:description: Professional clip-on wireless lavalier lapel microphone system for mobile creators, vloggers, and interviewers. Featuring seamless plug-and-play operation with no app or Bluetooth pairing required, 20-meter stable 2.4GHz wireless transmission range, 360° omnidirectional audio pickup with intelligent DSP noise reduction, and up to 6 hours of continuous recording battery life.

item.g:title: DZ09 Micro SIM Standalone Smartwatch Phone with Camera, Bluetooth & SD Card Slot
item.g:description: Versatile standalone smartwatch phone with dedicated Micro SIM and TF memory card slots. Make and receive phone calls, send SMS text messages, take photos with the built-in 2.0MP camera, and listen to MP3 music directly from your wrist. Features a 1.44-inch responsive TFT touch screen, Bluetooth connectivity, pedometer step tracker, sleep monitor, anti-loss protection, and multi-day standby battery.

item.g:title: MagSafe Vacuum Suction Magnetic Folding Car & Desk Phone Mount Holder
item.g:description: Sleek and robust magnetic smartphone holder crafted from aerospace-grade aluminum and zinc alloy. Features a rotary twist-to-lock vacuum suction base that adheres firmly to windshields, dashboard screens, mirrors, and tiles. Built with strong N52 neodymium MagSafe-compatible magnets, a multi-axis folding articulated arm, 360° rotation, and a closed-loop magnetic ring that prevents cellular and GPS signal interference.

item.g:title: Cyberpunk 40W 4-Port Fast Wall Charger (1x Type-C PD + 3x USB-A QC 3.0)
item.g:description: Compact high-performance 40W 4-port wall charging adapter designed in an eye-catching cyberpunk aesthetic. Equipped with one high-speed USB-C Power Delivery (PD) port and three USB-A Quick Charge 3.0 ports, allowing simultaneous fast charging for up to 4 devices from a single wall socket with intelligent power distribution and advanced low-temperature heat dissipation.

item.g:title: Extended XL Office Software Shortcut Keys Gaming Mouse Pad & Desk Mat (80 x 30 cm)
item.g:description: Upgrade your productivity and workspace aesthetic with this extended XL desk mouse pad. Measuring 80 x 30 cm, it accommodates both your full-sized keyboard and mouse. Featuring a clear reference cheat sheet of essential office keyboard shortcuts (Excel, Word, Photoshop & Windows), an ultra-smooth micro-weave tracking surface, reinforced stitched edges, and a heavy-duty non-slip textured rubber base.

item.g:title: A9 Mini Full HD 1080p Wireless Wi-Fi Magnetic IP Security Camera
item.g:description: Ultra-compact wireless Wi-Fi IP mini surveillance camera designed for discreet home, office, and car monitoring. Features 1080p HD live video streaming, 90° wide-angle field of view, 6 infrared auto-sensing night vision LEDs, smart motion detection with instant smartphone push alerts, built-in strong magnetic mounting, and TF microSD card storage up to 64GB with remote access via the JXLcam app.

item.g:title: Heavy-Duty 360° Mechanical Long-Arm Dashboard & Windshield Car Phone Mount (ZP-X0566)
item.g:description: Premium mechanical long-arm car smartphone holder engineered for ultra-secure navigation and hands-free driving. Features an industrial-grade vacuum suction base that locks firmly onto car dashboards and windshields, a dual-joint articulated arm extending up to 10 inches, 360° ball head rotation for seamless landscape/portrait viewing, one-touch auto-clamping claws, and shock-absorbing non-slip silicone cushioning.

item.g:title: G63 Smart G-Shape RGB Atmosphere Lamp with Wireless Charger, Bluetooth Speaker & Alarm Clock
item.g:description: Futuristic all-in-one G-Shape bedside gadget combining a 10W fast Qi wireless charging pad, 360° Hi-Fi Bluetooth 5.0 stereo speaker, 7-color RGB dynamic atmosphere lighting, and an LED digital alarm clock. Perfect for bedroom nightstands, office desks, or living room ambiance, allowing you to charge your phone wirelessly while streaming music and setting customizable sleep-aid lighting.

item.g:title: Hexagon Smart Multi-Plug Extension Socket Power Strip (4 AC Outlets + 4 USB Ports)
item.g:description: Space-saving hexagonal desktop power strip designed to eliminate plug crowding. Features 4 universal AC power outlets compatible with international and local plugs, 4 high-speed smart USB charging ports for mobile devices, a master push-button power switch with LED indicator, and fire-resistant heatproof construction with 1.8-meter heavy-duty pure copper cord.

item.g:title: JBL NE-013 Wireless Bluetooth Sports Neckband Earphones with Deep Bass & Mic
item.g:description: Ergonomically engineered wireless Bluetooth neckband earphones designed for immersive music lovers, sports athletes, and daily commuters. Features high-fidelity dynamic acoustic in-ear drivers delivering signature punchy bass, magnetic lock earbuds, a built-in high-sensitivity noise-reduction microphone, responsive multi-function controls, and an efficient battery providing up to 10 hours of non-stop playtime with 1.5-hour fast charging.

item.g:title: Smart Wireless Wi-Fi Video Doorbell Camera with Indoor Chime & Two-Way Audio
item.g:description: Upgrade your home security with this smart wireless Wi-Fi video doorbell and indoor chime receiver. When a visitor presses the doorbell button, it automatically captures high-resolution snapshot images and sends an instant push notification directly to your smartphone. Equipped with two-way voice talkback, infrared night vision, Type-C rechargeable battery, and remote smartphone monitoring via the Kement app.

item.g:title: BL2U SY286D 20000mAh 22.5W Super Fast Charging Power Bank with Digital Display
item.g:description: High-capacity 20,000mAh portable power bank engineered with 22.5W Super Fast Charging and 20W Power Delivery (PD) protocols. Features built-in fast-charging output cables, an integrated silicone carry lanyard handle, a crystal-clear LED digital battery percentage screen, and multi-protocol intelligent circuit protection. Airline flight approved and designed to charge multiple devices simultaneously with maximum efficiency.

item.g:title: Adjustable POV Chest Strap Harness Mount for Smartphones & Action Cameras
item.g:description: Capture immersive first-person point-of-view (POV) hands-free video footage on your smartphone or action camera. Features high-elastic breathable nylon straps with a 5-point fully adjustable buckle system that comfortably fits all body sizes. Includes a quick-release J-Hook buckle mount, reinforced phone clamp with vertical and horizontal rotation, and secure lock screw for extreme sports, motovlogging, cycling, hiking, and travel.

item.g:title: Boltove 6-in-1 Portable Smartphone Vlogging Kit (800Lm LED Light + Mic + Tripod Grip)
item.g:description: Compact 6-in-1 Boltove mobile video creation kit tailored for content creators, vloggers, and live streamers. Features an ultra-bright 800 Lumens 6500K daylight LED video light with multi-level brightness, a high-fidelity directional noise-filtering shotgun microphone, a universal 360° smartphone clamp, a wireless Bluetooth shutter remote, and a foldable desktop tripod that doubles as an ergonomic handheld camera grip.

item.g:title: Google Chromecast Full HD 1080p Wireless Wi-Fi HDMI Media Streaming Dongle
item.g:description: Stream your favorite entertainment in Full HD 1080p from your smartphone, tablet, or laptop directly to your TV. Google Chromecast plugs into your TV's HDMI port and uses your home Wi-Fi network to cast movies, sports, YouTube, Netflix, music, games, and entire browser tabs with zero lag. Features Google Home app integration, screen mirroring for Android & iOS, and Ambient Mode to display Google Photos, weather, and clock when idle.

item.g:title: AY-49 Smartphone Vlogging Kit (Noise-Reduction Mic + 49-LED Fill Light + Mini Tripod Grip)
item.g:description: Complete all-in-one AY-49 content creator video making kit designed for YouTubers, TikTokers, vloggers, journalists, and live streamers. Features a high-sensitivity directional noise-reduction shotgun microphone for crystal clear audio, a 49-LED ultra-bright studio fill light with adjustable brightness, a universal 360° phone mount clamp, a wireless Bluetooth shutter remote, and a 2-in-1 dual-mode tripod that converts instantly into an ergonomic handheld video stabilization pistol grip.

item.g:title: Magnetic Wireless Bluetooth Sports Neckband Earphones with Built-in Mic
item.g:description: Lightweight and flexible wireless Bluetooth neckband earphones crafted for active sports, running, workouts, and daily hands-free calling. Features magnetic clasp earbuds that snap together securely around your neck when not in use, heavy deep bass dynamic stereo acoustic drivers, in-line 3-button multimedia controls, intelligent voice noise reduction, and an ultra-light 30g skin-friendly contoured neckband.

item.g:title: Ultra-Mini Stealth Wireless Bluetooth Single In-Ear Earpiece Headset
item.g:description: Ultra-compact and discreet single-ear Bluetooth hands-free earpiece engineered for safe driving, business calls, and stealth audio listening. Features an anatomical anti-skid ergonomic ear-contour design that sits securely and almost invisibly inside either ear. Equipped with high-definition voice clarity, built-in noise-canceling mic, single-button call/playback control, and up to 3 hours of continuous talk time.

item.g:title: AirPods Pro ANC Edition Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds with Charging Case
item.g:description: High-value AirPods Pro style True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Bluetooth earbuds featuring Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) for an immersive listening environment and Transparency mode for keeping aware of your surroundings. Includes three pairs of soft tapered silicone ear tips for custom comfort and optimal acoustic seal, sweat and water splash resistance, responsive stem touch controls, and a compact magnetic charging case.

item.g:title: Dell MS-111 Wired USB Ergonomic Optical Mouse (1000 DPI)
item.g:description: Reliable and high-precision Dell MS-111 wired USB optical mouse designed for seamless office productivity, study, and everyday computing. Equipped with a responsive 1000 DPI high-definition optical LED tracking sensor that delivers fluid, accurate pointer movement on virtually any surface without moving parts to wear out or collect dust. Features a comfortable ambidextrous curved profile and durable plug-and-play USB connectivity.

item.g:title: JBL Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Earbuds with Charging Case
item.g:description: Compact and powerful JBL true wireless stereo (TWS) Bluetooth earbuds engineered with rich dynamic bass and crisp vocal clarity. Features ARM processing architecture for ultra-stable low-latency wireless transmission, ergonomic in-ear comfort fit for extended listening sessions, smart one-touch playback and call controls, and a lightweight pocket-friendly magnetic charging cradle.

item.g:title: 7-in-1 Dual-Input Aluminum USB-C & USB-A Multiport Hub Docking Station
item.g:description: Versatile 7-in-1 anodized aluminum USB expansion hub and docking station featuring an innovative dual 2-in-1 tethered USB-C and USB-A host connector. Expands a single port into 1x SuperSpeed USB 3.0 (5Gbps), 4x USB 2.0 ports, 1x USB-C high-speed data port, and 1x USB-C PD 60W pass-through charging port. Sleek space-gray aluminum chassis delivers rapid thermal heat dissipation, full OTG functionality for tablets/smartphones, and driverless plug-and-play operation across Windows, Mac, and iPadOS.

item.g:title: 3-in-1 Fast Charging Braided Cable with Real-Time LED Digital Power Display (1.2M)
item.g:description: Versatile 3-in-1 multi-connector fast charging cable equipped with an intelligent real-time LED digital power display hub that monitors charging status. Integrates USB Type-C, Apple Lightning, and Micro-USB outputs on a single high-density nylon braided cable—enabling simultaneous charging of 3 different devices from one USB port. Engineered with reinforced bend-resistant strain-relief joints and anti-tangle exterior.

item.g:title: Apple iPhone 20W USB-C Power Adapter + Type-C to Lightning Fast Charging Cable Combo
item.g:description: Complete 20W Power Delivery (PD) fast charging kit for Apple devices containing a 20W USB-C high-efficiency wall adapter and a matching 1-meter Type-C to 8-Pin Lightning cable. Engineered for swift and safe power delivery—charging compatible iPhone models from 0% to 50% in approximately 30 minutes. Built with comprehensive over-voltage, thermal heat management, and over-current protection. Backed by a 1 Month Service Warranty.

item.g:title: AirPods Pro (2nd Gen) Wireless ANC Bluetooth Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case
item.g:description: Premium AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) style True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Bluetooth earbuds featuring high-fidelity dynamic sound drivers with Adaptive EQ and ultra-deep bass. Equipped with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, iOS instant animated pop-up pairing, Qi-compatible wireless magnetic charging case, stem force touch controls, IPX4 sweat/water resistance, and interchangeable soft silicone ear tips. Includes a 1 Month Service Warranty.

item.g:title: 120W Super Fast Charging 3-in-1 Liquid Silicone Cable (Type-C / Lightning / Micro-USB)
item.g:description: Heavy-duty 120W 3-in-1 universal super fast charging cable manufactured with premium ultra-soft liquid silicone and reinforced zinc alloy metal connectors. Houses USB Type-C, Apple Lightning, and Micro-USB tips on a single rugged cable—enabling simultaneous rapid charging of 3 different devices. Features built-in LED charging status indicator lights, 10,000+ anti-bend endurance, and tangle-resistant skin-friendly silicone jacket.

item.g:title: JBL Wireless Bluetooth 5.3 True Wireless Stereo (TWS) Earbuds with Charging Case
item.g:description: High-performance JBL wireless True Wireless Stereo (TWS) earbuds engineered with signature pure deep bass and crystal-clear acoustic fidelity. Features stable Bluetooth 5.3 ultra-low latency wireless streaming, sensitive touch-control sensors for calls and playback, high-definition dual noise-filtering microphones for hands-free calling, ergonomic comfort-fit ear tips, and a sleek magnetic charging case providing up to 20 hours of combined playtime.

item.g:title: Multifunctional 3-in-1 Bluetooth Selfie Stick Tripod with LED Fill Light (101cm)
item.g:description: Versatile 3-in-1 multifunctional handheld Bluetooth selfie stick, sturdy desktop tripod stand, and vlogging phone holder. Features an extendable stainless-steel telescopic pole reaching up to 101cm for wide-angle group shots and travel captures, a detachable wireless Bluetooth shutter remote (10M range), an integrated rechargeable LED beauty fill light for low-light recording, 360° rotatable multi-angle phone clamp, and non-slip folding tripod feet.

item.g:title: RECRSI 4-Port 6A High-Speed Desktop Fast Charger Dock with Type-C Cable
item.g:description: Multi-functional RECRSI 4-Port 6A rapid desktop charging hub designed to charge up to four devices simultaneously from a single wall outlet. Delivers up to 6A strong total output power with intelligent current shunt technology that optimizes power for each connected smartphone, tablet, smartwatch, or power bank. Includes a complimentary high-speed fast charging Type-C cable and features a space-saving compact vertical dock design.

item.g:title: KAKUSIGA 20W PD Type-C to Lightning Braided Fast Charging Cable (2M)
item.g:description: Premium KAKUSIGA 2-meter extra-long Type-C to Apple Lightning fast charging and high-speed data sync cable. Supports 20W Power Delivery (PD) rapid charging capable of boosting iPhone batteries from 0% to 50% in approximately 30 minutes. Constructed with high-density ballistic nylon braiding, reinforced bend-resistant strain relief connectors, and pure copper wiring for maximum durability in bedrooms, cars, and offices.

item.g:title: Jedel K13 Full-Size USB Wired Multimedia Office & Gaming Keyboard
item.g:description: Reliable Jedel K13 full-size wired USB keyboard designed for smooth typing productivity in office environments, study workstations, and casual desktop gaming. Features a standard 104-key layout with dedicated numeric keypad, responsive tactile membrane keycaps rated for over 10 million keystrokes, integrated FN multimedia shortcut keys, ergonomic tilt legs, and instant driver-free plug-and-play USB connectivity.

item.g:title: RECRSI X-Series iPhone Fast Charger Set (USB Power Adapter + Lightning Cable)
item.g:description: Complete 2-in-1 RECRSI X-Series iPhone fast charging combo kit containing a high-efficiency USB wall power adapter and a 1-meter durable USB-A to 8-Pin Lightning data sync cable. Built with intelligent smart-chip circuitry to safeguard against overvoltage, overcharging, and thermal overheating for safe daily charging across Apple iPhone 14/13/12/11/X/8/7/SE series, iPad, and AirPods.

item.g:title: Ironstone High-Durability 2A Fast Charging & Data Sync Cable (1M)
item.g:description: Reliable Ironstone series 2A fast charging and high-speed data transmission cable. Built with reinforced strain-relief joint collars to withstand heavy bending, twisting, and daily friction, thickened pure copper core wiring for stable rapid power flow, and universal compatibility across USB Type-C, Apple Lightning, and Micro-USB smartphones, tablets, and power banks. Backed by a 3 Months Limited Warranty.

item.g:title: Morbest TB81-25CA 25W Dual-Port USB & Type-C PD Fast Wall Charger Adapter
item.g:description: High-efficiency Morbest TB81-25CA 25W multi-port wall charger adapter engineered for rapid, safe charging of modern smartphones and tablets. Equipped with dual charging slots—a 25W Power Delivery (PD) Type-C port and a high-speed USB-A port—enabling simultaneous charging of two devices. Features intelligent power distribution, compact flame-retardant casing, and multi-tier circuit protection against overheating, overcharging, and short circuits.

item.g:title: T800 Ultra Smartwatch with Bluetooth Calling & Health Tracking
item.g:description: Next-generation T800 Ultra smartwatch featuring a 1.99-inch HD full-touch display and aerospace-grade styled square alloy body. Supports direct Bluetooth calling & notifications from your wrist, 24/7 comprehensive health suite (Heart Rate, SpO2 Blood Oxygen, Blood Pressure, ECG trends, and Sleep analysis), multi-sports activity tracking, wireless magnetic fast charging, interchangeable ocean wave silicone straps, and IP67 water resistance.

item.g:title: Magnetic MagSafe Foldable Ring Selfie Fill Light & Mirror for iPhone & Android
item.g:description: Compact MagSafe magnetic snap-on ring selfie fill light with integrated makeup framing mirror. Equipped with powerful N52 neodymium magnets that snap securely onto iPhone 16/15/14/13/12 series (and non-MagSafe phones via the included adhesive metal ring adapter), 180-degree flip hinge for illuminating both front selfie and rear primary cameras, 3 bi-color lighting modes with smooth stepped dimming, and rechargeable battery for content creators on the go.

item.g:title: X Tag Smart GPS Bluetooth Locator Tracker (Works with Apple Find My)
item.g:description: Precision mini GPS Bluetooth smart locator tag seamlessly integrated with Apple's official 'Find My' network. Easily track and find misplaced keys, wallets, backpacks, suitcases, bicycles, and pets directly from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Features worldwide crowdsourced positioning, audible high-decibel lost item buzzer, ultra-lightweight 8.2g body with durable ABS shell, and up to 1-year replaceable CR2032 battery life.

item.g:title: Kingston DataTraveler 50 8GB High-Speed USB 3.0 Pen Drive
item.g:description: Compact and durable Kingston DataTraveler 50 (DT50) 8GB high-speed USB 3.1 Gen 1 / USB 3.0 flash drive. Delivers swift file transfers with a premium capless brushed metal casing and purple key loop accent. Lightweight, pocket-friendly, and backward compatible with USB 2.0 ports across PCs, laptops, and multimedia sound systems.

item.g:title: Ivon CA-54 Metal Heavy-Duty Fast Charging iPhone Lightning Cable
item.g:description: Rugged Ivon CA-54 premium heavy-duty all-metal fast charging and data syncing Lightning cable for Apple devices. Engineered with a flexible stainless-steel metal coil armor jacket that resists fraying, crushing, and pet chewing, reinforced alloy connector tips, and thickened pure copper wiring for rapid power delivery and high-speed data transfer across iPhone 14/13/12/11/X/8 and iPad models.

item.g:title: Target AI Bluetooth Smart Audio Sunglasses with UV400 & Magnetic Lenses
item.g:description: Futuristic Target AI open-ear smart audio sunglasses seamlessly combining high-fidelity wireless sound with premium eye protection. Features Bluetooth 5.3 wireless connectivity, dual open-ear directional stereo speakers, built-in HD microphone for crystal-clear hands-free calls and voice assistant access, responsive touch controls on the temple arms, UV400 eye protection clear base frames with snap-on polarized magnetic sunglass attachments, and up to 8 hours continuous audio on a single charge.

item.g:title: Budi PD 65W Aluminum Shell Type-C to Type-C Fast Charging Cable (1M)
item.g:description: Heavy-duty Budi 65W Power Delivery (PD) Type-C to Type-C fast charging and high-speed data transfer cable (1 Meter). Crafted with high-grade aluminum alloy connector shells, reinforced strain relief joints, premium braided exterior, and thickened pure copper core wiring supporting up to 65W rapid power delivery for laptops, MacBooks, iPads, Samsung Galaxy, and Xiaomi smartphones.

item.g:title: 180° Rotatable Wireless Sports Bluetooth 5.3 Headset with LED Power Display
item.g:description: Professional ergonomic on-ear wireless Bluetooth 5.3 single-ear sports & business headset with 180° rotatable earhook design that comfortably fits either left or right ear. Features directional concentrated beam audio transmission for crystal-clear conversations, smart LED digital battery display, dual noise-canceling mic for hands-free driving & workout calls, 180mAh battery delivering up to 15 hours playtime with 30-day standby, and fast USB Type-C charging.

item.g:title: USB Wireless Bluetooth Audio Music Receiver with 3.5mm AUX & Built-in Mic
item.g:description: Compact USB Bluetooth wireless audio receiver dongle designed to convert traditional wired car stereos, home theater soundbars, and vintage speaker systems into Bluetooth-enabled audio setups. Features high-definition stereo audio transmission, an integrated microphone for clear hands-free driving calls, LED status indicator, simple plug-and-play operation, and includes a 3.5mm male-to-male auxiliary patch cable.

item.g:title: Universal Touch-Sensitive Waterproof Phone Pouch Dry Bag with Neck Lanyard
item.g:description: Essential universal waterproof phone pouch dry bag designed to safeguard smartphones against water, torrential monsoon rain, sand, dust, and snow. Constructed from high-density transparent optical TPU/PVC with dual-sided ultra-clear windows that maintain 100% responsive touchscreen sensitivity for texting, answering calls, and capturing underwater photos. Features a secure multi-layer seal lock system and includes a heavy-duty adjustable neck lanyard for hands-free beach trips, swimming, water parks, and boating.

item.g:title: Vintage Retro Camera Design Wireless Earbuds with Circular LED Display (KFG Q86)
item.g:description: Unique and stylish Sound by KFG Q86 wireless earbuds featuring an eye-catching vintage camera-inspired charging case. Crafted with a premium two-tone cream and textured brown faux-leather wrap, the case features a circular camera-lens style digital LED display that dynamically shows remaining battery percentage. Powered by advanced Bluetooth 5.4, Hi-Fi stereo acoustic drivers delivering punchy deep bass and 360° panoramic audio, responsive smart touch controls, and built-in HD microphone for crystal-clear hands-free calls.

item.g:title: 802.11n 300Mbps High-Gain USB Wireless Wi-Fi Adapter with Rotatable Antenna
item.g:description: High-speed 300Mbps USB wireless Wi-Fi adapter dongle equipped with a 10.8cm high-gain rotatable external antenna for superior long-range signal reception. Instantly upgrades desktop PC towers, laptops, and older computers to fast 2.4GHz IEEE 802.11n wireless internet without needing internal cards. Features wireless roaming technology, multi-angle antenna swivel (360° rotation, 90° tilt), and robust WPA/WPA2 security encryption.

item.g:title: Cyberpunk 20000mAh Transparent Fast Charging Power Bank with 4 Built-In Cables

Features an industrial see-through front casing displaying the internal motherboard circuits, 4 built-in ribbon cables (Type-C, Apple Lightning, Micro-USB, and USB-A) for tangle-free multi-device charging, a smart circular digital LED battery percentage display (0–100%), and a heavy-duty yellow carry loop strap for travel and daily commute.

item.g:title: Universal 360° Rotatable Metallic Finger Ring Holder & Kickstand
item.g:description: Ultra-slim universal metallic finger ring holder and desktop kickstand for smartphones. Features a 360-degree omnidirectional rotatable base and 180-degree folding ring hinge for customizable viewing angles in portrait or landscape mode. Built with high-grade durable metal alloy, strong non-marking adhesive backing, and an ergonomic anti-drop finger grip to ensure secure one-handed phone operation.

item.g:title: USB to DC 9V/12V Step-Up Power Boost Cable for Wi-Fi Routers & Modems (1M)
item.g:description: Plug-and-play 1-meter USB to DC step-up voltage converter power boost cable. Converts standard 5V DC input from any portable power bank, laptop, or USB adapter into a stable 9V or 12V DC output (up to 1A). Equipped with a standard USB-A input and universal 5.5mm x 2.1mm DC barrel connector to power Wi-Fi routers, 4G LTE modems, SLT Fibre units, CCTV cameras, and mini LED lights continuously during power cuts.

item.g:title: Plokama U20 Pro Clip-On LED + RGB Fill Light with Selfie Mirror & 180° Swivel
item.g:description: Ultra-portable clip-on LED and RGB content creation fill light designed for smartphones, tablets, and laptops.
